verdict.rationale: Plaid documents an official, Plaid-hosted remote Dashboard MCP server that agents can connect to, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Its tools cover Production diagnostics, Item debugging, Link conversion data and usage metrics, not core financial-data API operations. Missing for 10: MCP tools for core API products (transactions, auth, balance), documented connection/auth setup details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
